basics.name: Matias Rios
basics.label: Tech Lead | Product & Platform Engineering
basics.summary: I shipped my first software for a client in 2019, while still at university. I bring 5+ years in product engineering teams and today I lead engineering and architecture at Mango, across hands-on delivery, system design, and team execution. I also co-founded Geome7ric as a side venture.
basics.about:
I build at Mango, a data company with financial products for the construction ecosystem in Latin America. My work focuses on the systems that power the platform: commercial credit, payment workflows and a network of 200+ points of sale. On my own time, I design and ship digital products end to end — from database architecture to payments and deployment. Previously, I helped take a mobile app from beta to the app stores at Nuqlea and drove a key integration at Kalkomey that increased subscriptions and revenue.

When I'm not at the computer, I’m usually at the gym, playing soccer at the best friend's club of my city, or with friends and family. I also manage projects at Geome7ric, my software venture.

work.name: Mango
work.summary: I lead the technical evolution of a multi-product fintech platform, connecting business strategy, architecture, and execution. My impact has evolved from hands-on implementation across payments and integrations toward designing products, standards, and delivery mechanisms that help the team operate with greater quality, security, and predictability.
highlights: Designed Mango’s engineering system: separated roadmap, backlog, specs, and ADRs from a versioned agent layer distributed to consumer repos through PRs.
Directed the migration of 15 functional modules from Vue 2 to Next.js while preserving critical workflows and contracts with the existing backend.
Strengthened the reliability of financial integrations through observability, health checks, traceability, and automated rollback.
Raised the security and delivery baseline through secret scanning, protected branches, and required checks across critical services.
Turned quality, observability, and technical debt into planned and measurable engineering capacity.
Coordinated cross-functional deliveries across Product, Engineering, and Data, including an operational collections intelligence surface.

work.name: Geome7ric
work.summary: I co-founded Geome7ric and lead client software projects alongside my work at Mango. For Badger, I shipped an industrial-inventory app and back office to production; I have also built tools for field operations. I own architecture, implementation, and delivery.
highlights: Co-founded Geome7ric, leading product strategy, technical architecture, and client relationships.
Built and shipped multiple custom products end-to-end: AI knowledge assistants, carpooling apps, and multi-tenant platforms.
Designed and deployed production systems using Next.js, React Native (Expo), Supabase, PostgreSQL, and Mercado Pago.
Managed full project lifecycles, including budgeting, client relations, project management, and team leadership.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines, Vercel deployments, and spec-driven development workflows.
Responsible for client acquisition, requirements gathering, and ensuring successful project delivery.

work.name: Kalkomey
work.summary: Worked through RazorTech on HuntWise, a Kalkomey product, and progressed from backend execution to technical leadership across its API and CMS. Coordinated delivery with Product, Marketing, and engineering teams, and was promoted for leadership and technical contributions.
highlights: Designed and implemented an integration between Kalkomey systems that enabled more efficient subscription and revenue workflows.
Established a test suite and reusable tooling from scratch for common scenarios, improving code reliability and maintainability.
Standardized the API architecture to replace monolithic controllers and improve organization, scalability, and maintainability.
Led delivery across the API and CMS and contributed to release planning and code reviews.
Maintained solutions on AWS, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, and Route 53.

work.name: Cargill
work.summary: Provided backend engineering services to Cargill through RazorTech, delivering for an international client and evolving existing integrations and services.
highlights: Delivered features and third-party API integrations within sprint commitments.
Identified bottlenecks and applied test-driven solutions to fix defects and improve performance.
Sustained code quality and delivery continuity through peer reviews and close team collaboration.

work.name: Nuqlea
work.summary: Contributed to the full-stack development of a hybrid B2C mobile application and its transition from beta to production on the App Store and Google Play, working across architecture, backend, and user experience.
highlights: Designed and developed mobile and backend workflows with Quasar (Vue.js), Laravel, and MySQL, contributing to the platform's architectural evolution.
Prepared the application for production by resolving performance issues and managing releases to the App Store and Google Play.
Contributed significantly to platform design and architecture, enhancing features for a B2C application.
Improved application performance and UX/UI by tackling system-wide issues and refactoring key components.
Operated effectively in an agile startup environment, consistently meeting tight deadlines and adapting to evolving requirements.
Utilized MySQL for database management and JavaScript (ES6+) for frontend and backend logic.

work.name: Indoscience / Profertil
work.summary: Completed my supervised professional practice at Indoscience S.A., providing services to Profertil S.A. I worked in a real industrial operation, administering servers and automating observability, backup, and maintenance tasks to reduce manual work and improve operational continuity.
highlights: Administered and monitored Windows Server, SQL Server, and Aspen InfoPlus.21 environments used by industrial operations.
Automated daily checks and maintenance tasks with Python, SQLPlus, and PowerShell.
Diagnosed backup, disk-capacity, antivirus, and data-collection failures, helping reduce IP.21 system interruptions.
Implemented bulk tag creation, operational displays, and historical alarm migrations.
Documented technical and operational procedures to improve support, traceability, and knowledge transfer.

projects.name: Platform v2
projects.description: Led the migration of 15 functional modules from a legacy Vue 2 application to Next.js while preserving parity across critical customer, purchasing, sales, supplier, payment, registration, and operational workflows.
projects.impact: Coordinated the migration of 15 business capabilities into a server-first Next.js architecture, separating domains while preserving contracts with the existing backend.

projects.name: Mango Engineering + Agentic
projects.description: Built Mango’s engineering system in two layers: mango-engineering centralizes planning and decisions; mango-agentic versions rules, agents, and skills and syncs them to consumer repos.
projects.headline: Cross-repo planning and a versioned agent layer for Mango.
projects.impact: Separated roadmap, backlog, specs, and ADRs from shared rules and agents; the agent layer is versioned and reaches consumer repos through PRs.
highlights: Canonical roadmap and backlog for cross-repo initiatives.
Portable agent layer with rules, agents, and skills as the source of truth.
Versioned sync to consumer repos through PRs.

projects.name: Transactions
projects.description: Microservice to automate payment processing through STP (Mexican banking network). Handles webhooks, transaction status tracking, and event-driven notifications with Sentry monitoring.
projects.impact: Automated STP payment processing with webhooks, transaction status tracking, event-driven notifications, and Sentry monitoring.

projects.name: Mango Credit Health
projects.description: Operational dashboard of credit and payment invariants to detect issues in the financial platform.
projects.impact: Defined the scope and criteria with the team for a health dashboard that turns credit and payment rules into actionable engineering signals.

projects.name: Eagle
projects.description: Field service management platform. Technician scheduling, work order tracking, photo evidence capture, and real-time dashboards for operations teams.
projects.impact: Built workflows for coordinating technicians, work orders, and field evidence with real-time tracking and operational dashboards.

projects.name: Lemur
projects.description: Corporate transport management system with real-time GPS tracking, route optimization, driver assignment, and live map visualization using Socket.io.
projects.impact: Implemented GPS tracking, driver assignment, route optimization, and live maps for corporate transportation operations.

projects.name: Badger
projects.description: Industrial inventory management for a manufacturing company. Turborepo monorepo with web dashboard and mobile app for warehouse floor operations.
projects.headline: Mobile + backoffice platform for industrial inventory operations.
projects.impact: We shipped an inventory/assignments platform to production: Android release, production backoffice, health checks, and monitoring.
highlights: Monorepo with Expo/React Native mobile app, Next.js backoffice, Supabase, and shared packages.
Inventory, assignments, rentals, roles, and warehouse-floor operations.
Documented delivery with Android rollout, health checks, and post go-live support window.

visual.alt: Editorial image of inventoried industrial parts with a scanner and stock ledger.

projects.name: Wolf
projects.description: Complete POS and commerce platform with sales, orders, cash management, analytics, team management, and Tienda Nube e-commerce sync.
projects.impact: Unified sales, orders, cash management, analytics, and Tienda Nube synchronization in a single commerce platform.

projects.name: Asiento Libre
projects.description: Carpooling app for Argentina. Visitors can explore, search, and publish trips, request seats, and coordinate bookings; payments are integrated in a controlled flow.
projects.headline: An app for sharing intercity trips in Argentina.
projects.impact: Designed and built the mobile experience for passengers and drivers, then validated payment, cancellation, and refund in a controlled test across the app, backend, and Mercado Pago.
proof: Payment, cancellation, and refund validated in a controlled test
highlights: Route/waypoint engine for Argentine corridors and trip search.
Defined acceptance criteria and safety rails for validating a financial flow without widening its risk surface.
Reconciled app, Mercado Pago, and Supabase evidence before approving the Android release.

visual.alt: Editorial image of an intercity route map connecting two points, with a car key.

projects.name: Turna
projects.description: Online booking for professionals: public booking page, real-time availability, Google Calendar sync, and WhatsApp reminders. Includes an AI assistant to manage the agenda.
projects.impact: Built real-time booking, Google Calendar synchronization, WhatsApp reminders, and an AI scheduling assistant for professionals.
